name: Coming of Mage
source: Nineal, an elf from the Homeland Forest, is the brightest student in a prestigious magic academy. After finishing his first year of study, he is required to complete a year-long apprenticeship with a professional mage from the city of Taurea. Only after meeting his new master's expectations will he be granted the honor of becoming a real mage - but will things really be as simple as that?
translation: 来自故土森林的精灵奈尼尔，是一所著名魔法学院里最出色的学生。完成第一年的学业后，他必须前往陶雷亚城，跟随一位职业法师进行为期一年的学徒修行。只有达到新导师的要求，他才能获得成为正式法师的殊荣——可事情真的会这么简单吗？
